item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00198","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C17","C02","C12"],"selected_candidate_label":"C17","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C17 plausibly supplied the concrete legal and administrative template for a material portion of the child. The child defends essentially the same machinery established in C17: an eighteen-member tripartite Wage Stabilization Board, preservation of collective bargaining, Board jurisdiction after bargaining and mediation fail, voluntary submission or presidential referral of disputes, recommendations for fair settlement, and binding decisions only with the parties' prior agreement. It reproduces this architecture in nearly the same sequence and sometimes closely parallel language.
